reviews.title: Beautiful birth!
reviews.contents: If you only do one thing to prepare for birth, let this be it!! This was hands down the most helpful thing for my labor. I only started listening to this in the last 5 weeks of pregnancy but I wish I had found it sooner! I listened to it every night in the bathtub and sometimes falling asleep at night. By the time labor started, I thought I’d be listening to it more but my body was consumed by an outside force that only allowed me to focus inward. My husband took some videos during my labor and I heard myself speaking some of the hypnosis phrases out loud. I have no memory of this!! I unfortunately never got around to listening to the “pushing” tracks so I wonder if that would have gone a bit differently for me. I did listen to the postpartum tracks in the weeks following my birth which really helped me mentally. The nature sounds we’re also really helpful for getting my newborn to sleep. I have been recommending this app to all my pregnant friends. I will be using this again from the beginning of my next pregnancy! Thank you for helping me have the most beautiful and positive birth experience. 10 stars!!!!

reviews.title: Pairs Well with MasterClass
reviews.contents: While the app itself can be a bit clunky at times, the content is incredibly valuable — it helps with sleep, offers affirmations, an eBook plus workbook, and looks like it will be very helpful during birth as well. I appreciate the small tasks each day because they fit into my schedule easily. After the free trial I took the plunge and paid for the monthly subscription, expecting to only stick with it for a couple months until the baby is born (I’m 35 weeks pregnant now). Apparently you get a 50% discount on the MasterClass with a subscription so I gave it a try (note: the first time I tried purchasing the class Apple took my money and still showed the class as unavailable. But I requested a in-app purchase refund and the second time I tried the purchase it worked). Compared with other online childbirth courses that are hundreds of dollars, this was something I could justify the cost for!

reviews.title: “Easiest birth I’ve ever seen”
reviews.contents: I downloaded this app the last month of pregnancy as a crash course in Hypnobirthing and to help me calm the anxiousness I was feeling giving birth during a global pandemic. I was pregnant with my 4th baby and had done natural birth previously, but never using Hypnobirth techniques per se. I listened to these meditations every night as I was falling asleep and throughout the day during a little nap or rest. I completely believe that the compounding benefits of using it are real! When it came time to deliver my baby I had the most controlled and peaceful, unmediated birth. I didn’t even yell out in pain once and was able to calmly direct my husband and doctor in what support I needed. After my baby was born my doctor, who has been delivering babies for 40 years, said “That was the easiest birth I’ve ever seen. It was like slow motion. It was hard to tell when you were pushing it was so quiet.” I’m grateful to have had this app as one of my birth preparation tools, it was so helpful!

reviews.title: Excellent wholesome program
reviews.contents: The gentlebirth app, with premium purchase, is an incredible program to follow throughout pregnancy and postpartum.  I love Tracy’s voice and cadence throughout the variety of meditations. The curated meditations per day and accessibility to the entire lot of meditations, ability to love and save your favorites, every meditation broken down into its category and easy to find, are all features that make the app itself very user friendly and it also has a nice visual appeal.  On top of the app having so many meditations to follow, the guidebook and workbooks are wonderful bonuses to add to the wealth of knowledge that Tracy has cultivated in her program.  Don’t forget to check out the online support groups on instagram and facebook!

reviews.title: Good, not Great
reviews.contents:
Out of all the hypnobirthing options out there, I’ve got to say that this is a pretty good one. Accessible, not expensive, good mix of audios. 
However, a few things could make this great:

1. It is currently 5am and I can’t sleep. I tried the Sleep Sanctuary audio, which says it is 44 minutes long. BUT 12 minutes into this meditation there’s a wake up sequence. What? Why?? Who plans on taking a 12 minute nap??? Especially one that’s supposed to be a sleep sanctuary... Many of the audios have a wake up sequence that should NOT be there.

2. I enabled autoplay for playlists, but I still have to pick up my phone to press play in between every audio for the day. When I’m trying to get, and stay, in a meditative mood, the most unhelpful thing is having to come out of my meditative state every 5 to 10 minutes to press play for the next audio.  Daily playlists should have autoplay working. 

3. Other voice options would be nice. While not a major game-changer, especially since the current voice is a lovely, soothing voice, there is an accent and some words are accented enough that I’m semi-jolted out of the meditative state. 

4. I wanted to contact this app-maker directly through the Contact Us link within the app, but it prompts me to redownload the original email app that came with the phone that I deleted. I don’t know if that’s an app flaw or an Apple/iPhone flaw, but it would be nice to see the email typed out so I could contact the company with the email that I do use.

reviews.title: Nice practice
reviews.contents: Good for reinforcement of positive mantras and relaxation techniques. Note to developers the sound is not equalized from track to track. Some levels are very soft and barely audible and others are too loud when adjusted for soft tracks. Second, I think it would be nice to have an option for automatic play through for each days practice, since I practiced at night and would have to click forward to each track manually disrupting the flow and mess with my phone instead of having it automatically play on. Also, in the labor tab the favorites is a nice feature, but I do not enjoy the pop up that appears every time you want to leave one track to make sure you want to leave the track. It’s a waste of time especially if you are in discomfort looking for the right track to play. All in all liked the app just needs a bit of fine tuning.

reviews.title: Helping me feel prepared
reviews.contents: I’m a first time mom, and having these meditations to listen to are really making me feel like I’m taking action in preparation for birth. I thought it was silly at first until I was watching a movie that had a birth scene come on, and my mind instantly went to “calm, confident, and in control”. That’s when I realized we need a training to revert to in a time of uncertainty or stress, and prompted me to pay for the app (I had just used the free version for a week thus far). The app is at least more affordable than similar online classes and it’s been working with my schedule!

reviews.title: Helped me in labor
reviews.contents:
The app was confusing and not very user friendly for me, and even though I paid the monthly subscription it seemed like there were still things I needed to pay for or “unlock.” I didn’t have time or the patience for that. 

BUT that being said I did use this app and the 9 minute “GentleBirth Affirmation” download. (This was the only thing I used.) I found it helpful to listen to in the third trimester of both my pregnancies and even found myself repeating these affirmations during labor. Would I use it again? Yes, probably because now it’s a mental thing for me. Could I find something similar for free? Probably- but again, so I have the time or patience?

reviews.title: I only have one issue, but it’s a big one
reviews.contents:
Hey developers, I just purchased the full version. I loved the different recordings, until I came to “Wellness Hypnosis” 
For some reason, the visualization with going down the staircase makes me nervous. I cannot calm down or be in control, my mind wanders and I feel as if I’m going into unfamiliar, unsafe territory. Which is so sad because it’s opened up this can of worms where I don’t even have control of my own mind. I tried visualizing going upstairs instead, but then I feel like I’ve died and gone to heaven. I have decided to skip the recording altogether. I am just disappointed since it’s almost a 30 minute recording I’m missing out on. Any recommendations on a substitute recording? Thanks

reviews.title: Positively perfect
reviews.contents: At the beginning of my pregnancy I was excited and felt energized to be honored with the opportunity to bring life into this world! As we started to share our news we received positive feedback, but there was still the books and studies and articles that crept in and made things seem scary. I knew that it couldn’t be that bad. I was built for this. A friend referred the Gentle Birth app to me and I was hooked! I love the positivity and encouragement I received daily, and the in depth truths of the book. I haven’t started the workbook just yet, but I feel fully confident that it will just add that much more peace of mind to our first babies birth!
